messages:
Omar N.: deploy-bot flagged a sustained p95 regression in ap-southeast for release v4.0.0-canary. It suggests auto-revert but change_window ends in 10m. Thoughts? :wave:
Priya V.: what's the signal?
deploy-bot: SUGGESTION: automatic revert -> stable-2026-04. reason: p95_latency>300ms (slo=250ms) & increased tail OOMs. auto-reverts suppressed during change_window(02:00-03:00 UTC). To force: /deploy revert --force (ops-only).
Hannah (oncall): we shouldn't auto-force during change_window because of live customers, but we also can't leave the regression. proposal: staged traffic cutback: 100% -> 60% canary / 40% stable for 10m, then 20/80 if still trending. less disruption for customers in apac meeting SLA.
Omar N.: agree on staged cutback. Also try a variant without the new allocator: v4.0.0-no-fastalloc and throttled kv-cache. If that recovers, no revert needed.
Priya V.: ops command available: `/deploy split --region=ap-southeast --from=100 --to=60 --target=stable-2026-04` then `/deploy route --region=ap-southeast --target=v4.0.0-no-fastalloc --percent=40`. Ops-only.
Infra Watch: Note: v4.0.0-no-fastalloc variant has passed canary across other regions but shows +2.5% cost.
Hannah (oncall): executing staged cutback now. will post metrics at +5m and +10m.
deploy-bot: ACTION LOGGED: manual-split by Hannah at 02:11 UTC -> canary 60% / stable 40% in ap-southeast.
Hannah (oncall): +2m: p95 down 18% vs peak, error-rate unchanged. Smoke tests green for top 10 customers.
Omar N.: switching 40% to no-fastalloc variant now to validate variant hypothesis.
Priya V.: doing it. `/deploy route --region=ap-southeast --target=v4.0.0-no-fastalloc --percent=40`
deploy-bot: ACTION LOGGED: manual-route by Priya at 02:15 UTC.
Hannah (oncall): +5m after variant pin: p95 back within SLO in ap-southeast, error-rate dropped to baseline. Looks like allocator change caused regressions under certain memory patterns.
Omar N.: great. decision: keep v4.0.0-no-fastalloc in ap-southeast and open INF-4400 for a proper fix. No full revert. Priya, please draft a 1-liner for release-notes and add to postmortem queue.
Priya V.: release-notes: "Applied targeted variant pin in APAC for v4.0.0 to mitigate allocator-induced tail latency; customers unaffected. Follow-up fix planned (INF-4400)." PR incoming.
CS Ops: will prepare customer-facing note in case major accounts ask; tag legal if needed.
Infra Watch: adding temporary alert: ap-southeast variant-p95 > 260ms for 3m -> page oncall.
Hannah (oncall): creating INF-4400 with traces and heap profiles attached. tagging runtime-team.
Omar N.: thanks all. leaving this thread open until INF-4400 lands. will schedule a short blameless postmortem after root cause identified. :white_check_mark:
